title: Bilevel Learning via Strategically Inexact Stochastic Gradient Descent
abstract: arXiv:2511.06774v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Bilevel optimization is a central tool in computational imaging for high-dimensional hyperparameter tuning; prominent applications include learning data-adaptive regularizers and optimizing forward operators in variational regularization. However, due to the nested nature of the problem, exact gradients with respect to the parameters (so-called hypergradients) are not available: the precision of the hypergradient is linearly related to the computational cost, thus requiring algorithms which can solve the problem without unnecessary precision. In learned-regularizer pipelines, the inner reconstruction solver is typically run for a fixed number of iterations, leaving the hypergradient accuracy uncontrolled and existing convergence theory inapplicable. translated_title: 基于策略性不精确随机梯度下降的双层学习
translated_abstract: 双层优化是计算成像领域中进行高维超参数调优的核心工具；其重要应用包括学习数据自适应正则化器以及在变分正则化中优化前向算子。然而，由于问题的嵌套特性，无法获得关于参数的精确梯度（即所谓的超梯度）：超梯度的精度与计算成本呈线性关系，因此需要能够在不产生不必要精度开销的前提下求解该问题的算法。在可学习正则化流程中，内层重建求解器通常仅运行固定次数的迭代，导致超梯度精度不受控制，使得现有的收敛理论不再适用。在本工作中，我们分析了实践者实际使用的调度方案：我们证明了不精确随机双层优化的收敛性，并在精度衰减等多种条件下建立了收敛速率……
tldr: 该论文针对计算成像中的双层优化问题，证明了实践者实际采用的不精确随机梯度调度方案可保证收敛，并在超梯度精度与计算成本线性相关、精度衰减衰减等条件下建立了收敛速率。
en_tdlr: This paper proves convergence of inexact stochastic bilevel optimization under the strategically inexact schedules practitioners actually run, establishing convergence rates when hypergradient precision scales linearly with computational cost.
